name: TED Search API v3 and official notice downloads
owner: Publications Office of the European Union

access.rate_limit_description: The admitted AXIGNAL profile performs one fixed Search API request, one page and at most three active notices. Wider pagination and arbitrary expert queries are outside this admission.

rights.notes: Product admission is limited to the fixed non-personal Search API projection in ted-search-non-personal-projection@0.1.0. Procurement notices may be reused subject to source acknowledgement, indication of changes, non-distortion and additional rights. Contact data, protected logos, third-party protected material, arbitrary queries, API redistribution, bulk redistribution and model training are excluded.

freshness.expected_cadence: Weekday OJ S publication; official TED daily XML package available by 09:30 on publication days according to the source help page.
